title: Copperlark Studios
text:
Copperlark Studios

notes:
Mid-market B2B product analytics platform. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (fast PoC) then plan to move to Dedicated VPC for production. Security-heavy buying process; security team lead (Amir Khalid) running SOC2 gap analysis. Key quote from CTO: "Need SSO + audit logs and retention controls before we commit to dedicated capacity." PO wants predictable per-token economics and fallback routing to cheaper variants for non-sensitive workloads. Pricing sensitivity but willing to pay for SLA and isolation. Priorities: 1) run 2-week PoC on hosted to validate prompts/latency, 2) security review for Dedicated/VPC (networking, KMS, audit), 3) finalize commit size and contract term.

recent_activities:
2026-01-28 - Intro call: Jordan Park + Priya Nair with CTO (Samira Velazquez) and Product lead. High-level ask: reduce embedding costs and serve support-agent chat at <=120ms p95.
2026-02-10 - PoC kickoff (hosted): engineering sent sample dataset (50k docs). Fireflies: ff_2026-02-10_74321. Action: Redwood to provide token-estimates and latency profile.
2026-02-18 - Tech deep-dive: SE (Priya) demoed batching/caching; discussed KV cache for session chat. Product asked about cold-start behavior.
2026-02-24 - Security sync: presented Redwood Dedicated VPC architecture; Amir requested SOC2 evidence and network diagram. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-24_78219. Drive: security-faq-response doc.
2026-03-02 - Pricing runbook shared (workbook v2). Copperlark requested committed throughput tiers and burst pricing examples.
2026-03-04 - Internal security follow-up: Copperlark flagged retention policy detail (90-day vs custom). Redwood to confirm retention_controls and audit log retention options.
2026-03-05 - AE updated record: awaiting security review sign-off and internal procurement calendar (end of May).
POC notes: hosted PoC showing ~150ms median for chat with 2k concurrent users; embedding batch run matched cost targets but needs Dedicated for data residency and audit.
Security open items: SOC2 report (in progress), SSO/SAML integration test account, KMS/HSM key management workflow, audit log export to customer SIEM.
